data.title: New SEC rules would fleece everyday investors to enrich Wall Street
data.description:
A previous version of this report misrepresented the aggregate assets held in mutual funds in the U.S. The accurate figure is $45 trillion, according to Investment Company Institute data. It has been corrected. Robert PozenEmily Gee

The agency should ensure funds' risks are clear

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, led by Chairman Paul Atkins, has released proposed rules that would expose retail investors to higher fees and riskier assets.

New proposals from the Securities and Exchange Commission will tilt the scales in favor of Wall Street and against a huge group of retail investors.

At the end of 2025, approximately 130 million Americans held assets of $45 trillion in mutual funds. The SEC recently released a raft of proposed rules that would expose everyday retail investors to higher fees and riskier assets by allowing one-sided performance fees and making it easier to sell retail funds holding illiquid private securities.

Mutual funds have historically charged much lower fees than private funds reserved for sophisticated investors. Under the Investment Advisers Act, mutual funds may pay an annual management fee plus balanced "fulcrum" fees. These penalize an adviser for poor performance to the same extent they reward good performance. For example, if a performance-fee structure increased fees by 20 basis points in a year when the manager outperformed the S&P 500 index SPX by 10%, it would have to decrease fees by 20 basis points in a year when the manager underperformed that same index by 10%.

The SEC now proposes allowing mutual-fund managers to adopt the fee structures common in private funds: charging higher fees for good performance while suffering no penalties for bad performance. Furthermore, these fees could be calculated based on unrealized, "paper" gains. This is a major departure from the historic standard of net realized gains - thus, permitting managers to pocket performance fees on temporary highs that may vanish the next year.

Under this policy, mutual funds could newly adopt the fee structures typical of private funds, a 1% or 2% management fee and a performance fee of up to 20%. Imagine an investor whose mutual fund gains in paper value in one year but suffers actual losses in year two. The investor would pay $2,000 in performance fees for the first year's unrealized gains of $10,000, with no fee reduction in year two even if those unrealized gains turned into actual losses of $10,000. The SEC is essentially asking mutual-fund investors to accept a rigged proposition: "Heads I win, tails you lose."

The result for investors would be lower returns and higher volatility. Because advisers profit from gains but bear no downside risk, they would be incentivized to chase high returns and push investors into riskier investments. Over time, this fee structure would eat into the returns of retail investors, diminishing the hard-earned savings that middle-class Americans rely on for mortgages, tuition and retirement.

The SEC proposal would make it easier for private equity and private credit funds to sell shares to retail investors. These individuals often lack the financial expertise to evaluate the assets held by these funds, or the means to absorb significant losses from these risky investments. Current SEC rules protect everyday savers by limiting private market investments to accredited investors who meet specific financial thresholds: an annual income of $200,000 ($300,000 for couples) or net worth of $1 million, excluding a primary residence.

Because these thresholds were established in the 1980s and never adjusted, they're already insufficient. To reflect inflation since 1982, the net-worth requirement should be $3.5 million today, and the income threshold should be $693,000 for individuals and over $1 million for couples. Yet the SEC is moving in the opposite direction. It is maintaining these outdated financial thresholds while broadening the definition of an accredited investor to include anyone holding specific finance-related credentials, like a CPA or a CFA, regardless of their financial resources.

Already, business development corporations with private credit holdings are fueling a redemptions crisis among retail investors, who likely didn't understand the complex risks associated with the securities of private companies. The SEC's new proposal would make it even easier for Wall Street to market funds designed to hold illiquid private equity or debt.

Historically, private equity and private debt funds imposed lock-ups that prevented accredited investors from accessing their funds for long periods of time. To market these assets to retail investors, managers developed "semi-liquid" vehicles like interval funds and business development companies. These vehicles allow investors to redeem shares quarterly - but usually only up to 5% of a fund's assets.

The new SEC proposals would allow sponsors to operate these vehicles more flexibly. They could offer to repurchase shares from shareholders monthly rather than quarterly. They could be marketed via multiple distribution arrangements including sales loads and monthly marketing fees. Most importantly, the proposal extends the buffer period before a fund must make its initial repurchase offer. This gives managers more time to build portfolios of private companies before ever having to honor a withdrawal request.

The SEC is moving in the wrong direction by allowing mutual funds to charge one-sided performance fees and encouraging Wall Street to sell more private assets to unsophisticated buyers. Instead, the SEC should bolster investor protections by increasing the criteria for accredited investors to reflect inflation, and by ensuring all retail investors fully understand the risks in buying funds holding illiquid securities of private companies.

Robert Pozen is a distinguished senior lecturer at MIT Sloan School of Management and a former president of Fidelity Investments.

Emily Gee is the senior vice president for economic policy at the Center for American Progress.

-Robert Pozen -Emily Gee

data.title: KBRA Assigns Rating to $500 Million Senior Unsecured Notes Issued by Cantor Fitzgerald, L.P.
data.description:
KBRA Assigns Rating to $500 Million Senior Unsecured Notes Issued by Cantor Fitzgerald, L.P.

KBRA assigns a rating of BBB with a Stable Outlook to the $500 million senior unsecured notes issued by Cantor Fitzgerald, L.P. (“Cantor”, "CFLP", or “the firm”) with a final maturity date of October 15, 2029. The proceeds will be used to refinance existing senior unsecured debt of $350 million that was scheduled to mature on April 14, 2027 and for general corporate purposes.

Domiciled in New York, NY, Cantor is a privately held capital markets, investment banking, and asset management firm that wholly owns two SEC-registered broker-dealers and maintains controlling stakes in a publicly traded wholesale inter-dealer brokerage company and a CRE brokerage, capital markets and client services company. Principal subsidiaries include Cantor Fitzgerald & Co, CF Secured, LLC, BGC Group, Inc. (“BGC”), Newmark Group, Inc. (“NMRK”), and Cantor Fitzgerald Asset Management.

Key Credit Considerations

The ratings are underpinned by management’s long record of producing relatively steady operating results, adapting to business and market evolution and opportunity, emphasizing risk management, and maintaining consistent financial leverage and liquidity management practices. The ratings are further reinforced by the financial flexibility that comes from Cantor’s flow securities trading operations and agency inter-dealer and CRE brokerage businesses, together with mostly overnight repo lending that is supported by disciplined collateral margin requirements.

Consolidated profitability in 2025 was very strong, and this performance continues through 2Q26, driven by several factors, including the favorable market backdrop and demand for Cantor’s products and services, including at its core broker-dealer businesses but also at BGC and NMRK. Financial leverage continues to be maintained within a relatively narrow range, reaching a cyclical low in 2025 due to the strong earnings performance and net capital raising efforts at CFLP (consolidated). KBRA continues to anticipate that adjusted financial leverage will be managed in the 5x range on a through-the-cycle basis. Liquidity continues to benefit from the nature of the agency-like business activities, balance sheet flexibility, and ample unsecured, committed borrowing capacity.

Rating Sensitivities

Cantor’s ratings are well positioned at the current levels, reflective of the current strong financial performance in 2025. Conversely, although unlikely, a change in the firm’s stringent enterprise risk management policies and practices or liquidity management would pressure the ratings. A change in the revenue profile, which would be most likely to come from a secular dislocation in either the wholesale brokerage or CRE brokerage and financing business, would also cause the ratings to be evaluated.

To access ratings and relevant documents, click here.

Methodology

  • Financial Institutions: Securities Firm Global Rating Methodology

Disclosures

A description of all substantially material sources that were used to prepare the credit rating and information on the methodology(ies) (inclusive of any material models and sensitivity analyses of the relevant key rating assumptions, as applicable) used in determining the credit rating is available in the Information Disclosure Form(s) located here.

Information on the meaning of each rating category can be located here.

Further disclosures relating to this rating action are available in the Information Disclosure Form(s) referenced above. Additional information regarding KBRA policies, methodologies, rating scales and disclosures are available at www.kbra.com.

About KBRA

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA), one of the major credit rating agencies (CRA), is a full-service CRA registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an NRSRO. Kroll Bond Rating Agency Europe Limited is registered as a CRA with the European Securities and Markets Authority. Kroll Bond Rating Agency UK Limited is registered as a CRA with the UK Financial Conduct Authority. In addition, KBRA is designated as a Designated Rating Organization (DRO) by the Ontario Securities Commission for issuers of asset-backed securities to file a short form prospectus or shelf prospectus. KBRA is also recognized as a Qualified Rating Agency by Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission and is recognized by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners as a Credit Rating Provider (CRP) in the U.S.

data.title: Blinksoft Sets a New Standard for Business Phone Support with Three-Ring Answer Guaranteed
data.description:
LONG ISLAND, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Blinksoft, a New York-based provider of AI-enabled business phone systems, today announced a company-wide commitment to customer service as its primary competitive differentiator, backed by a set of support standards the company says are unmatched in the VoIP industry.

At the core of the commitment is Blinksoft's three-ring answer policy: every support call is picked up by a live, US-based technician within three rings, with no phone tree and no offshore queue. Each customer is also assigned a single named Client Concierge who serves as their point of contact for the life of the account, from onboarding and training through billing questions and system changes.

When a business phone system goes down, every minute costs money, and the last thing an owner should have to do is sit on hold with the company they pay to keep them connected. We built our support model around a simple idea: you should reach a real person who already knows your account, fast. That's not a premium add-on for us. It's the product.

Blinksoft's support standards include:

  • Three-ring answer policy. Live support calls are answered by a US-based technician within three rings.
  • A named Client Concierge for every account. One dedicated contact who knows the customer's setup, history, and team.
  • US-based technicians and on-site support. Remote troubleshooting backed by in-person service when a visit is the fastest fix.
  • 611 dialing on every install. Support is programmed directly into every phone Blinksoft deploys, so help is one three-digit dial away from any desk.

Unlike many providers that resell third-party platforms, Blinksoft designs and builds the software that runs its phone system in house. The company says that ownership of the full stack allows its support team to resolve issues at the source rather than escalating tickets to an outside vendor, and to ship fixes and features based directly on customer feedback.

Blinksoft's platform combines traditional business phone functionality with built-in AI capabilities including call recording, AI-powered transcription, and business texting. The company reports that customers switching from legacy providers save an average of at least 20 percent on their phone costs. Blinksoft serves businesses nationwide, with its largest customer base in the New York tri-state area.

Businesses interested in learning more about Blinksoft's phone systems and support model can visit https://blinksoft.ai.

About Blinksoft

Blinksoft is a Long Island, New York-based technology company that designs and delivers AI-enabled business phone systems for small and mid-sized businesses across the United States. Combining in-house software with live, US-based support, Blinksoft helps businesses communicate more efficiently while reducing phone costs. Learn more at https://blinksoft.ai.

data.title: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. Announces Shareholder Approval of Proposed Business Combination with Forge Nano, Inc.
data.description:
CLAYMONT, Del., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (Nasdaq: ATII) (“Archimedes II” or “ATII”), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company, today announced that at the Extraordinary General Meeting (the “Meeting”) held today, October 16, 2026, ATII’s shareholders voted to approve the previously announced business combination (the “Business Combination”) between ATII and Forge Nano, Inc. (“Forge Nano”), as well as all other proposals related to the Business Combination considered and voted upon at the Meeting.

The Business Combination is currently expected to close in the coming days, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of remaining closing conditions. Upon closing, the combined company (“Pubco”) is expected to operate as Forge Nano Holdings, Inc. and its shares of common stock and warrants are expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbols “NANO” and “NANOW,” respectively.

The results of the Meeting, as tabulated by an independent inspector of elections, will be included in a current report on Form 8-K to be filed by ATII with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”).

About Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co.

Archimedes II is a Cayman Islands exempted company led by Chairman Eric R. Ball and CEO Long Long and is comprised of technology investors, corporate-finance veterans, engineers, and SPAC specialists. Archimedes II was formed as a special-purpose acquisition company for the purpose of effecting a merger with one or more businesses in the technology industry. Archimedes II completed its $230 million IPO in February 2025, and its units, ordinary shares, and warrants currently trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbols “ATIIU,” “ATII,” and “ATIIW,” respectively. The team’s prior SPAC, Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners Co., successfully closed its merger with SoundHound AI, Inc. in April 2022. Learn more at www.archimedesspac2.com.

About Forge Nano, Inc.

Forge Nano is a leading U.S.-based semiconductor equipment and advanced materials company pioneering Atomic Layer Deposition (“ALD”) technology for AI-era chip manufacturing and defense battery applications via its platform technology, Atomic Armor®. Atomic Armor® is a scalable, adaptable nano-scale coating system that strengthens America’s most critical systems – at the atomic level. The superior surface coatings produced by Forge Nano’s Atomic Armor® process allow partners to unlock peak performance. Learn more at www.forgenano.com.

Important Information and Where to Find It

In connection with the proposed business combination, Pubco, a wholly-owned subsidiary of ATII, and Forge Nano have filed documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), including a registration statement on Form S-4 (the “Registration Statement”), which includes ATII’s proxy statement/prospectus, relating to the proposed business combination. The Registration Statement was declared effective by the SEC on September 22, 2026. ATII’s shareholders approved the business combination at the extraordinary general meeting held on October 16, 2026. Investors and security holders may obtain free copies of these documents and other related documents filed with the SEC at the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov or by directing a request to: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co., 2093 Philadelphia Pike #1968, Claymont, DE 19703.

Participants in the Solicitation

Each of ATII, Pubco, Forge Nano and their respective directors, executive officers and other members of management and employees, under SEC rules, may be deemed to be “participants” in the solicitation of proxies from shareholders of ATII in favor of the proposed business combination. Information about ATII’s directors and officers is set forth in ATII’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, which was filed with the SEC on March 4, 2026 and ATII’s other filings with the SEC. Additional information concerning the interests of ATII’s participants in the solicitation, which may, in some cases, be different than those of ATII’s shareholders generally, is set forth in the Registration Statement relating to the proposed business combination. data.title: Qualia Legacy Advisors Advises The Blogger Agent on Sale to The Only Agency
data.description:
Qualia Legacy Advisors Advises The Blogger Agent on Sale to The Only Agency

Deal Expands The Only Agency's Footprint in the Creator Economy

Following the recent acquisition of The Blogger Agent by The Only Agency (“TOA”), a portfolio company of Presidio Investors, Qualia Legacy Advisors is pleased to formally announce its role as the exclusive sell-side advisor to The Blogger Agent on the transaction. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The acquisition pairs TOA's roster of top-tier fashion, hair, and makeup talent with The Blogger Agent's established network of beauty influencers. The deal gives TOA's existing client base — many of whom already have public followings built around their editorial and behind-the-scenes work — a direct path into creator representation and brand partnerships, while giving The Blogger Agent's creators access to TOA's platform and production network, including a direct foothold in the US market.

“Our talent creates the looks and images that shape fashion and beauty and The Blogger Agent’s creators bring those looks to audiences every day, allowing us to create a truly global talent platform,” said Kent Beldon, Founder and CEO of The Only Agency.

The transaction is the latest example of established talent and media businesses moving to capture a larger share of the creator economy, as brands continue to shift marketing spend toward influencer and creator partnerships.

“The Blogger Agent has built a category-defining roster in the beauty influencer space, and The Only Agency is exactly the right partner to help that platform scale globally,” said Isaac Palmer, Managing Partner at Qualia Legacy Advisors.

Aaron Meyerson, Managing Director at Qualia, added, “This combination creates a powerful two-way ecosystem. Elite stylists and artists can build personal brands as influencers, and established digital creators can elevate their profiles by working alongside top-tier celebrity talent.”

“Qualia found us the perfect partner in The Only Agency right off the bat and did an outstanding job negotiating and guiding me through this process from start to finish,” said Claudia Bish, owner of The Blogger Agent. “Isaac and Aaron’s unfailing responsiveness at every stage is what got us over the finish line.”

About The Only Agency

Headquartered in New York, The Only Agency is a portfolio company of Presidio Investors focused on representing top-tier fashion stylists and hair and makeup artists in the entertainment industry.

About The Blogger Agent

Headquartered in London, The Blogger Agent represents beauty influencers and digital creators, connecting its roster with brand partnerships and commercial opportunities across the UK and mideast.

About Qualia Legacy Advisors

With locations in New York City, Los Angeles and Toronto, Qualia Legacy Advisors is a boutique investment bank specializing in film, TV, live entertainment, digital media and the creator economy. The firm advises clients on sell-side and buy-side M&A, capital raising, restructuring and strategic transactions across the sector.

Securities offered through Finalis Securities LLC, member FINRA/SIPC. Qualia Legacy Advisors and Finalis Securities are separate, unaffiliated entities.

data.title: Power Integrations Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description:
Power Integrations Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)

Power Integrations (Nasdaq: POWI) today announced that on October 15, 2026 (the Grant Date), it granted a total of 25,325 RSUs and 1,339 PSUs at target to a total of 12 employees who began their employment with Power Integrations in September 2026.

The inducement grants were issued pursuant to Power Integrations’ Amended and Restated 2025 Inducement Award Plan. One-fourth (1/4th) of the RSUs will vest on each of the first four anniversaries of the respective Grant Dates, subject to the recipient’s continued service through each applicable vesting date. The PSUs will vest based upon achievement of the Company’s performance metrics for 2026, as determined by the Talent and Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors, up to a maximum of 200% of the target number of PSUs, subject to continued service through December 31, 2026. The inducement grants are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable RSU and PSU agreements and Power Integrations’ Amended and Restated 2025 Inducement Award Plan.

The inducement grants were approved by the Talent and Compensation Committee of Power Integrations’ Board of Directors, as required by Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4), and were granted as a material inducement to employment in accordance with Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4).

About Power Integrations

Power Integrations, Inc. is a leading innovator in semiconductor technologies for high-voltage power conversion. data.title: Emerging Growth Research Publishes Update on Newton Golf’s Pole Canyon Option and Critical Minerals Strategy
data.description:
NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Emerging Growth Research ("EGR") today announced the publication of a company-sponsored Flash Report covering Newton Golf Company, Inc. (NASDAQ:NWTG), a technology-focused golf equipment company that develops and sells premium golf shafts, putters and related products.

The report examines Newton Golf's recently announced option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property located in White Pine County, Nevada. It also discusses the Company's move into the U.S. critical minerals sector and the effect of the associated share issuance on EGR's earnings-per-share estimates.

Key Highlights

  • Pole Canyon Option - On September 24, 2026, Newton Golf announced it had completed a transaction granting it an option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property in White Pine County, Nevada. The transaction represents the Company's entry into the U.S. critical minerals sector.
  • Consideration - In connection with the option, Newton Golf issued shares equal to 19.9% of its issued and outstanding common stock. Using EGR's previous estimate of shares outstanding at the end of Q3:26, the issuance is estimated at approximately 1.13 million shares.
  • Critical Minerals - Beryllium appears on the U.S. Geological Survey's 2025 List of Critical Minerals, while tungsten is included on the U.S. Department of Energy's 2023 Final Critical Materials List. Both materials have applications in aerospace, defense and advanced manufacturing.
  • Project Overview - Pole Canyon is a past-producing property comprising 16 unpatented lode claims across approximately 330 acres, about 50 miles southeast of Ely, Nevada. Historical materials describe a mineralized system extending for more than 4,000 feet and reportedly open along strike and at depth. They also cite a historical estimate of approximately 281,725 tons grading 0.75% beryllium oxide and 0.30% tungsten trioxide. Newton Golf has not independently verified these historical estimates.
  • Strategy - Newton Golf has stated that it does not plan to begin mining operations at this time. The Company instead intends to consider potential strategic agreements, with the option structure providing exposure to the project while limiting near-term operating and capital commitments.
  • Estimate Updates - EGR does not expect the transaction to affect the Company's revenue or operating income and has not changed its revenue forecasts. Reflecting the additional shares outstanding, EGR's FY:26 loss-per-share estimate narrows to $(1.23) from $(1.37), and its FY:27 estimate narrows to $(0.38) from $(0.42).
  • Risks - Newton Golf continues to generate negative cash flow and may need to obtain additional capital to support its growth plans. Demand for its products may be affected by shifts in consumer preferences and sentiment, as golf equipment is discretionary. The Pole Canyon option is at an early stage, mining is not currently underway, and there can be no assurance the project will generate value for the Company.

data.title: UPDATE - Woodward Appoints Paxton McVoy as Chief Information Officer
data.description:
FORT COLLINS, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Woodward (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial energy control solutions, today announced the appointment of Paxton McVoy as Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer (CIO), effective Oct. 19, 2026. He will join the company's Executive Leadership Team, reporting directly to Chief Executive Officer Chip Blankenship.

In this newly created role, McVoy will lead Woodward's global information technology organization and set the direction for the company’s digital strategy, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), data and analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and technology-enabled business transformation.

McVoy joins Woodward from Veralto, where he was Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer. Following Veralto's separation from Danaher, he led the new public company's global technology strategy and operations and helped build Veralto's technology organization after the company became independent. His responsibilities included enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data and AI, infrastructure, procurement, and oversight of the ERP portfolio across 13 operating companies. Earlier in his career, he held senior IT leadership roles at Medtronic, including Vice President and CIO for the company's Surgical Innovations business. He also previously was instrumental in leading Medtronic's transition from Oracle to SAP. 

"Paxton has a proven history of using technology to improve business performance and leading digital transformation across complex global organizations like ours. In this role he will help us to set the direction for how information technology will support our long-term growth strategy," said Chip Blankenship, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Woodward. "His experience shaping enterprise technology strategy, advancing AI capabilities, and building strong teams will help us strengthen Woodward's digital foundation in line with our efforts to serve customers and create shareholder value."

"I am looking forward to joining Woodward at an important point in the company's growth," said McVoy. "Woodward's focus on innovation, operational excellence, and creating value for customers and shareholders creates a real opportunity to use technology as a strategic advantage. I look forward to working with the leadership team and Woodward members around the world to help ensure the success of the company's digital transformation."

McVoy holds a Bachelor of Arts in Business from Otterbein University and an MBA from The Ohio State University.

About Woodward, Inc.

Woodward is the global leader in the design, manufacture, and service of energy conversion and control solutions for the aerospace and industrial equipment markets. Our purpose is to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future. Our innovative fluid, combustion, electrical, propulsion, and motion control systems perform in some of the world’s harshest environments. Woodward is a global company headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, USA. Visit our website at www.woodward.com.

data.title: Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup
data.description:
Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup

Bloom’s $10,000 donation will help fund critical equipment, training and resources for first responders across Central Texas.

Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) continued its season-long partnership with ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour this week in Austin, Texas.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261016766768/en/

Ahead of the Florida-Texas matchup, Bloom visited Austin Fire Department Station #3 and presented a $10,000 donation to the Central Texas Public Safety Commission, a nonprofit organization that supports police, fire and EMS departments across Central Texas.

For more than 25 years, the Central Texas Public Safety Commission has worked with first responders and community partners to identify and fund critical needs, including equipment, training, wellness programs and community initiatives that strengthen public safety.

“Every community’s resilience ultimately depends on people,” said Natalie Sunderland, Chief Marketing Officer at Bloom Energy. “The firefighters, EMS personnel and first responders supported by the Central Texas Public Safety Commission are the people communities turn to on their hardest days. We are proud to support an organization that helps ensure they have the resources they need to serve Central Texas.”

“The Central Texas Public Safety Commission provides critical support for equipment, training and other needs that fall outside our normal operating budget,” said Austin Interim Fire Chief Tom Vocke. “Support from organizations like Bloom Energy helps supplement city resources and ensures our firefighters have what they need to stay safe and ready to respond.”

Austin Fire Department Station #3 opened in 1957 and serves the University of Texas and surrounding Central Austin neighborhoods. The station reopened in October 2023 following a renovation that rebuilt its apparatus bays and added dedicated spaces designed to improve firefighter health and safety while preserving the station’s original design.

Bloom will also be on the University of Texas campus Saturday during pregame festivities, where fans can take part in an interactive experience and learn more about Bloom's work, providing clean, reliable power for essential services and critical infrastructure across the country.
